WITH filtered_titles AS (
    SELECT t.id, t.title
    FROM title AS t
    WHERE t.production_year > 2005
),
ru_movie_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mc.movie_id
    FROM movie_companies AS mc
    JOIN company_name AS cn ON cn.id = mc.company_id AND cn.country_code = '[ru]'
    JOIN company_type AS ct ON ct.id = mc.company_type_id
),
voice_cast_info AS (
    SELECT ci.movie_id, ci.person_role_id, ci.role_id
    FROM cast_info AS ci
    WHERE ci.note LIKE '%(voice)%'
      AND ci.note LIKE '%(uncredited)%'
),
eligible_movie_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ft.id AS movie_id
    FROM filtered_titles AS ft
    JOIN ru_movie_ids AS ru ON ru.movie_id = ft.id
    JOIN voice_cast_info AS vci ON vci.movie_id = ft.id
    JOIN role_type AS rt ON rt.id = vci.role_id
    JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = vci.person_role_id
    WHERE rt.role = 'actor'
),
character_min_by_movie AS (
    SELECT em.movie_id, MIN(chn.name) AS min_character_name
    FROM eligible_movie_ids AS em
    JOIN voice_cast_info AS vci ON vci.movie_id = em.movie_id
    JOIN role_type AS rt ON rt.id = vci.role_id
    JOIN char_name AS chn ON chn.id = vci.person_role_id
    WHERE rt.role = 'actor'
    GROUP BY em.movie_id
)
SELECT
    MIN(cmin.min_character_name) AS uncredited_voiced_character,
    MIN(ft.title) AS russian_movie
FROM eligible_movie_ids AS em
JOIN filtered_titles AS ft ON ft.id = em.movie_id
JOIN character_min_by_movie AS cmin ON cmin.movie_id = em.movie_id
